title: ExecutionReceipt
description: Agent-execution envelope for the governed Executions Ledger. One ExecutionReceipt records a single agent run: the membrane ExecutionDecision that authorized it, the scoped capabilities it held vs. actually used, the verdict of its output, and the sealed proof artifact. It COMPOSES rather than duplicates: per-side-effect authorization stays in ActionReceipt (linked via action_receipt_ref), the autonomy axis reuses ScopedCapability.authority_band, and epistemic_level references SCOPE-D's proof-confidence axis. epistemic_level (proof confidence) and authority_band (autonomy ceiling) are DISTINCT axes and are deliberately not merged.

type.description: The class of activity the agent was responding to.

ref.description: Deep-link reference to the triggering item (e.g. an event or threat id).

decision.description: The membrane ExecutionDecision that authorized this run. verdict reuses the ActionReceipt policy_decision vocabulary; authority_band reuses the ScopedCapability autonomy ladder.

verdict.description: Reuses ActionReceipt.policy_decision. require_approval is the APPROVAL_REQUIRED state.

authority_band.description: Autonomy ceiling exercised for this run. Reuses ScopedCapability.authority_band. This is the L0..L5 autonomy axis and is NOT epistemic_level.

capabilities_held.description: ScopedCapability ids the agent held for this run (cap_ refs).

capabilities_used.description: Subset of capabilities_held actually exercised. Must be a subset of capabilities_held (enforced by the validator, not the schema).

verdict.description: The verdict of the agent's output. state is the ledger's own settled/held/refused axis; epistemic_level (optional) references SCOPE-D proof confidence and is a distinct axis from decision.authority_band.

epistemic_level.description: SCOPE-D proof-confidence axis (claim strength). NOT autonomy. Optional; present when a ProofArtifact carries a claim.

proof_artifact.description: The sealed artifact that makes the verdict checkable. sha256/replayable reuse the ActionReceipt receipt-hash discipline; a bare boolean status is never sufficient.

action_receipt_ref.description: Link to the ActionReceipt recording the per-side-effect authorization for this run. Present whenever the run produced a governed side effect.

blast.description: Link to the governed blast-radius (GBRG) reading for the resource this run touched. Populated by the containment engine.
